answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 99 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in canyon, queued in echo, and sparrow publishes the wait time. A farm of 79 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3235 identities would post 1450 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
